model: Sum of the parts: owner FCF DCF on the consolidated Automotive and Farm Equipment segments, plus listed and unlisted group stakes in the equity bridge (engine route)

equity_bridge.item: Tech Mahindra 248.0m shares at market less 20% holdco discount
equity_bridge.note: 248,022,598 shares (FY26 AR standalone note 8, associate) x TECHM.NS close on 2026-11-13 (Yahoo) = 437.5bn, x 0.80. Full market value would add Rs 78/share. Carried at cost of 9.7bn in the standalone accounts and 83.1bn equity-accounted in the consolidated.

equity_bridge.item: Mahindra Finance 52.49% stake at 1.2x book (justified P/B)
equity_bridge.note: Financial Services segment net assets at 30-Sep-2026: 1,744,020 - 1,523,860 = 220,160 (Q2 FY27 consolidated segment table) as net worth. Justified P/B = (ROE 14.5% - g 8%) / (CoE 13.5% - g 8%) = 1.18x, rounded to 1.2x. ROE basis: FY26 ~13% (segment PBT 37.1bn), H1 FY27 run-rate ~16% on a 61% profit jump and GS3 at 3.4%; a decade of history sits at 7-13%, so 14.5% is a through-cycle view, not the run-rate. 220,160 x 1.2 x 0.5249. Market value of the stake (729,582,599 shares x M&MFIN.NS close on 2026-11-13, ~1.8x book) is 209.8bn: Rs 63/share more than is counted here.

equity_bridge.item: Listed services subsidiaries (Lifespaces, Holidays, Logistics) at market less 20%
equity_bridge.note: Mahindra Lifespace 111,805,708 shares = 36.2bn; Mahindra Holidays 134,835,922 = 27.1bn; Mahindra Logistics 59,112,927 = 25.4bn (share counts FY26 AR note 8; Yahoo closes 2026-11-13). 88.7bn x 0.80.

equity_bridge.item: Unlisted services and other investments at cost
equity_bridge.note: FY26 AR standalone note 8, at cost: Mahindra Holdings (Susten, Accelo and others) 27,054; Mahindra Aerospace 12,055; Mahindra Agri Solutions 4,434; Mahindra Advanced Technologies 4,361; Mahindra Sustainable Energy 1,283; Brainbees (FirstCry, quoted, taken at cost) 3,511. Automotive and farm holding companies (MEAL, MOICML, Mahindra Automotive Mauritius, Classic Legends) are NOT here: their businesses are in the core flows.

equity_bridge.item: Minorities in core subsidiaries (MEAL, LMM, SML Mahindra, Swaraj Engines)
equity_bridge.note: MEAL: BII 18,500 + Temasek 12,000 invested = 30,500, converted to equity 1-May-2026 with exit at the higher of fair value and cost by 2031 (FY26 AR note 42). Mahindra Last Mile Mobility: 21.89% outside (IFC, India-Japan Fund) ~15,000. Swaraj Engines: 47.89% at market 20,300. SML Mahindra: 41.03% at 20,000 (market value 30.8bn at 47x earnings; earnings-based ~16bn). Deducting SML at market would take a further Rs 10/share.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: EPS 5-year CAGR (38.4%) diverges more than 30% from equity CAGR (17.5%): FY2021 is a COVID-depressed base (EPS 29.92). The 3-year figures (revenue 17.7%, EPS 18.3%, equity 18.2%) agree with each other and are the better guide.
historical_growth.notes: Consolidated, FY2021/FY2023 to FY2026, from the Metrics CSV. Equity is parent-only. FCF CAGRs are not computed: consolidated free cash flow is negative in six of the last eight years because Mahindra Finance loan growth runs through operating cash flow, and there is no consistent ex-financial-services series before the segment KPIs begin in FY2023. Core (Automotive + Farm) segment revenue grew 964.2bn to 1,604.0bn FY23-FY26, 18.5% a year, with FY26 alone +27% (GST cut, SML Isuzu consolidated from Aug-2025). SBC is ~0.2% of revenue, so owner and reported FCF growth do not diverge.

scenario_narratives.base: SUV volumes grow mid-to-high teens in FY27 on five launches and then slow toward the industry as Tata, Maruti and Hyundai/Kia answer in the Rs 10-25 lakh band; M&M holds roughly a quarter of SUV revenue share. Tractors are flat in FY27 on the 87%-of-LPA monsoon, recover in FY28 and compound mid-single-digit volumes with 43-44% share. Born Electric mix climbs from ~13% of SUVs and dilutes automotive margin about as fast as scale and PLI incentives restore it, so core EBITDA settles at the FY24-26 average of ~13.4% rather than expanding. Capex stays elevated through the Nagpur build (start of production 2028) and eases toward 4.4% of revenue. Mahindra Finance earns a mid-teens ROE; Tech Mahindra and the listed services stakes are worth what the market says less a holding-company discount.
scenario_narratives.bull: The launch cycle and exports (Indonesia, the global Pik-Up, South Africa) let M&M take SUV share for another three years, and the monsoon normalises so tractors return to high-single-digit growth with core tractor margins back above 20%. EV scale arrives ahead of plan, so battery cost-down and PLI turn Born Electric from dilutive to neutral and core EBITDA reaches 14.5%, a level M&M has touched only at standalone level. Trucks & Buses and Last Mile Mobility add growth without needing separate capital. Needs share gains, a kind monsoon cycle and EV margin parity at the same time.
scenario_narratives.bear: FY26-27 turns out to be the cycle peak: the GST-cut pull-forward unwinds, a second weak monsoon cuts tractor volumes (as in FY20, when consolidated revenue fell 28%), and SUV growth stalls as competitors' launches land. Commodity inflation is not recovered in price, EV price competition forces discounting on a rising EV mix, and CAFE 3 compliance costs arrive. Core EBITDA falls to ~11% (the FY19-22 range) while the Nagpur programme keeps capex at 6-7% of a smaller revenue base, so free cash flow is thin for three years before a partial recovery. The bridge is not flexed: in this world Mahindra Finance's rural book would also see credit costs rise, which the 1.2x book multiple only partly allows for.

valuation_philosophy.summary: M&M is valued as the sum of an automotive and farm-equipment operating business and a set of financial holdings. The operating business is a component owner-FCF DCF at a 12% INR cost of equity on the consolidated Automotive and Farm segments, with standalone treasury as net cash. Mahindra Finance is a lender, so its borrowings are operating funding and it enters on book value at a justified multiple; Tech Mahindra and the listed services subsidiaries enter at market less a 20% holding-company discount. The holdings and net cash together are roughly Rs 820 a share, so the question the price asks is what the auto and farm business alone is worth.
key_risks_to_valuation: Cycle position: FY26-27 core revenue growth of 27% and 22% follows a GST cut and a strong monsoon; capitalising margins and volumes from this point is the largest single judgment in the model.
The bridge is about a seventh of value and is scenario-invariant; Tech Mahindra alone is ~Rs 310 a share at an 80% haircut to a market price near its 52-week high.
Mahindra Finance is counted at 1.2x book against a market price of ~1.8x; using market would add ~Rs 63 a share, and a rural credit cycle would cut the other way.
Net cash of Rs 350 a share is standalone treasury, about 150bn of which is funded by trade payables exceeding inventory and receivables; a growth stall would unwind part of it.
Share count: 1,122m on the consolidated basis (trust-held shares treated as treasury) against ~1,243m listed; any distribution or sale of the trust shares would dilute outside holders by up to 10%.
EV economics: MEAL's margins after PLI incentives are not separately disclosed in the segment data; the base case assumes EV mix is margin-neutral over the decade.
Core capex and D&A are read from the consolidated segment note (FY26) and H1 FY27 cash flows; subsidiary-level cash and debt in MEAL, LMM and SML are not in the net-cash anchor.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 2,744.3-3,839.9. Bridge stakes priced off TECHM.NS, M&MFIN.NS, MAHLIFE.NS, MHRIL.NS, MAHLOG.NS, SWARAJENG.NS and SMLMAH.NS closes of 2026-11-13 from the same API.
data_sources.financials: M&M.NS_Quarterly_Q2-2027.txt (consolidated and standalone results, segment tables, balance sheets and cash flows at 30-Sep-2026); M&M.NS_Annual_FY2026.txt (standalone cash flow statement, standalone note 8 investments with share counts, consolidated note 42 CCPS, note 46 segment information: D&A and additions to non-current assets by segment); M&M.NS_Metrics.csv and kpis (segment revenue and operating income FY2023 onward).
data_sources.qualitative: M&M.NS_Analysis.json (2026-11-15): guidance from the Q2 FY27 analyst meet of 5-Nov-2026. One correction applied: Tech Mahindra is an associate, not a consolidated majority-owned subsidiary.

inputs.base_revenue_note: CORE ONLY: FY2026 consolidated segment revenue, Automotive 1,178,341 + Farm Equipment 425,684 (Q2 FY27 results, consolidated segment table, year ended 31-Mar-2026 column). NOT consolidated income from operations (1,986,386), which also carries Financial Services 209,493 and Industrial Businesses & Consumer Services 227,489.
inputs.share_count_basis: Consolidated diluted weighted count for H1 FY27: attributable PAT 100,424.2m / diluted EPS 89.48 = 1,122.3m (basic 1,117.8m). This is the consolidated basis, which eliminates M&M shares held by the M&M Benefit Trust and the ESOP Trust as treasury. The listed share count is ~1,243.5m and the standalone accounts show 1,202.7m (paid-up 601.36 crore at Rs 5), so a market cap computed from the exchange count overstates what outside holders own by ~10%. Held flat: SBC is expensed in the flows.
inputs.net_debt_note: CORE TREASURY ONLY: M&M standalone balance sheet at 30-Sep-2026 (Q2 FY27 results). Current investments 189,178.8 + cash and equivalents 11,397.4 + other bank balances 197,742.0 = 398,318.2. Borrowings 5,000.0 non-current + 265.5 current. EXCLUDED: Mahindra Finance borrowings (the bulk of consolidated borrowings of 1,493,854, operating funding of the NBFC and inside its book value in the bridge); cash and debt of the listed services subsidiaries (inside their market values); non-current 'other financial assets' of 28,415.6 (partly term deposits over 12 months, not split out in the interim accounts, so not counted); cash held inside MEAL, LMM and SML; lease liabilities 6,121 (treatment B). The consolidated cash and debt columns in the Metrics CSV are NOT the right anchor for this model. Roughly 150bn of this treasury is funded by negative working capital (standalone trade payables 351.2bn against inventory plus receivables 199.6bn).
inputs.fcf_note: M&M STANDALONE FY2026 (annual report standalone cash flow statement): operating cash flow 227,584.9 less capex 63,078.5 plus disposal proceeds 2,293.0. Consolidated FCF in the Metrics CSV (20,519 FY26; negative in most years) is after Mahindra Finance loan disbursements booked in operating cash flow and is meaningless for valuation. Standalone FCF is a memo anchor, not the projection base: it excludes MEAL, LMM, SML and the overseas farm units, and includes a working-capital release. The forward build starts from core segment revenue and components.
inputs.interest_income_note: Interest and dividends received are classified in investing activities, so they are not inside reported_fcf. Forward flows are built from segment results, which exclude unallocable treasury income; the treasury that earns it is in net_debt (matching-asset rule). Dividends from Tech Mahindra, Mahindra Finance and the listed services subsidiaries (17,691 in FY26) are likewise out of the flows and their stakes are in the bridge.
inputs.sbc_source: Standalone cash flow statement FY2026, equity-settled share-based payment expenses 297.91 crore (FY25 105.87 crore). Consolidated figure is 3,428.8 (Metrics CSV); the difference is mostly Mahindra Finance and services subsidiaries, outside the core. No net-share-settlement tax line (EquityAwardTaxes = 0). The FY26 step-up from ~0.1% to ~0.2% of revenue is carried forward, not faded.
inputs.buyback_note: No repurchase in any year FY2016-H1 FY27. ESOPs are satisfied from the ESOP Trust, so the flat count is a modelling convention that the 0.2% SBC charge pays for.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-11-13T09:58:04Z (15:28 IST Friday, regular NSE session, two minutes before the close)
inputs.wacc_rationale: INR-built: India 10-year G-sec ~6.5% + ~5.5% equity risk premium x beta ~1.0 = ~12.0% cost of equity. The core carries net cash, so WACC = cost of equity = 12.0%; same basis as LT.NS. One rate in all three scenarios: cyclicality, monsoon and EV-transition risk live in the flows and the weights. Terminal growth 5.5% base = ~4% RBI inflation target + ~1.5% real.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B): leases as operating cost. Standalone lease repayments including interest ran 1,074.7 in H1 FY27 (~2.1bn a year, ~0.13% of core revenue); charged at 0.15% via lease_cost_pct_path to allow for the automotive and farm subsidiaries. Lease liabilities excluded from net debt. da_pct_path is set ~0.1pt below segment D&A to remove right-of-use depreciation.
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged once, in the bridge. The core flows carry 100% of the Automotive and Farm segments, including four subsidiaries with outside holders (MEAL, Mahindra Last Mile Mobility, SML Mahindra, Swaraj Engines); their minorities are deducted as one bridge line. Mahindra Finance, Tech Mahindra and the listed services subsidiaries are NOT in the flows; only M&M's own shareholding enters the bridge, so their minorities are never counted. The Metrics CSV ShareholdersEquity is parent-only by design (NCI 176,605 at Sep-2026 sits in kpis).
inputs.notes: MODEL: sum of the parts, because the group straddles three rows of the dcf-methods routing table; same construction as LT.NS. (1) CORE = consolidated Automotive + Farm Equipment segments (FY26 revenue 1,604bn, segment EBIT 159.8bn = 10.0%, D&A 60.0bn, capex 82.4bn): owner-FCF component DCF with the non-US/cyclical adaptations. Consolidated segments are used rather than M&M standalone so that the EV company (MEAL), electric three-wheelers (LMM), SML Mahindra and the loss-making overseas farm units are inside the flows rather than carried at cost. (2) Mahindra Finance (NBFC, 52.49% owned): borrowings are operating funding and FCF is meaningless, so the stake is valued on book at a justified multiple, not by FCF and not at market. A consolidated owner-FCF DCF would treat ~Rs 1.4tn of NBFC borrowings as net debt and loan growth as negative FCF. (3) Tech Mahindra is an equity-accounted ASSOCIATE (248.0m shares, ~28%), not a consolidated subsidiary as the Analysis JSON states; it and the listed services subsidiaries (Lifespaces, Holidays, Logistics) enter at market less a 20% holding-company discount. (4) Unlisted services investments at cost. The equity bridge is scenario-invariant in the engine, so bear/base/bull differ only in the core; the stakes' own upside and downside are not flexed. First valuation of this ticker (no prior DCF, no memory entry). Price is a regular-session print, not after-hours. Guidance year is FY2027 (H1 reported 5-Nov-2026).

base.growth_note: FY27: core segment revenue was +26.9% in H1 (942.2bn vs 742.2bn) against guidance of mid-to-high-teens SUV volume growth, flattish tractors and ~5% pricing; H2 laps the post-GST-cut surge, so ~18% in H2 and ~22% for the year. Thereafter a fade from 13% to 7% against Indian nominal GDP of ~10%.
base.margin_note: Core segment EBIT margin: FY24 9.6%, FY25 10.2%, FY26 10.0%, H1 FY27 9.7% (H1 FY26 10.6%). Adding D&A gives segment EBITDA of 13.5-14.1%; 0.3pt is held back for unallocated corporate cost, which the segment table nets against treasury income. FY27 at 12.8% reflects the H1 commodity squeeze and guided Q3 tractor margin pressure; 13.4% from FY30 is the FY24-26 average, then a small fade as EV mix rises.
base.capex_note: Core additions to non-current assets were 90.4bn FY25 and 82.4bn FY26 (7.2% and 5.1% of core revenue). H1 FY27 cash capex jumped to 73.6bn consolidated (54.0bn standalone, 6.4% of standalone revenue) as the Nagpur greenfield and the next SUV/EV platforms start. Path holds capex above D&A throughout.
base.wc_note: Positive capture matches the balance sheet: standalone trade payables exceed inventory plus receivables by ~150bn (~9% of revenue), so growth releases cash (H1 FY27 standalone working capital +18.3bn). 3% of incremental revenue is a third of the stock ratio.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 18x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25%: tractors and SUVs are both cyclical, FY26-27 volumes and margins are at or near record after a GST cut, the monsoon has already turned, and the margin squeeze is in the reported H1 numbers rather than hypothetical. Base 50%: guidance, the launch pipeline and the capex programme all point at this path. Bull cut from 35% to 25%: it needs continued share gains, a benign monsoon cycle and EV margin parity together, and the stakes in the bridge are not flexed upward with it.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
